commands.author: qingminglong

target.title: fix: stop model catalog sidecar read/write races
target.body:
Closes #99390

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where gateway/model catalog readers could observe plugin catalog sidecar directories while the model catalog writer was updating them, causing `FsSafeError: directory changed during operation` warnings and retry loops during provider model discovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing `models.json` write serialization now also protects reads that depend on the same `models.json` plus generated plugin catalog sidecar snapshot. The fix keeps the coordination inside the agent model catalog owner boundary and does not add config, migrations, or provider-specific policy.

## User Impact

Operators should no longer see the model catalog reader race the generated sidecar writer and loop on directory-change warnings while provider catalog sidecars are being refreshed. Read-only model catalog browsing waits for the in-process write to finish, then reads a stable persisted catalog snapshot.

## Evidence

Current head: `2dbe0363cb9e4f9982afd1460e7a50a9435e6b7e`.

- Claim proved: read-only model catalog readers no longer race the generated provider catalog sidecar writer; the same isolated Anthropic catalog sidecar can be read through the gateway catalog owner path without `FsSafeError` / directory-change warning loops.
- Isolated live-provider setup:
  - `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` and `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH` pointed at a temporary proof root.
  - `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` was supplied only through the environment; API key redacted from all outputs.
  - Config enabled the Anthropic plugin with primary model `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6`.
- Live Anthropic sanity check:
  - `GET https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models` returned `status: ok`, `count: 9` at `2026-07-03T13:52:49.6219914Z`.
  - First model ids included `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-fable-5`, `claude-opus-4-8`, `claude-opus-4-7`, and `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
- Generated sidecar proof:
  - Relative sidecar: `state/agents/main/agent/plugins/anthropic/catalog.json`.
  - Size: `5137` bytes; mtime: `2026-07-03T13:12:00.9548247Z`; `generatedBy: openclaw-plugin-model-catalog-v1`.
  - Provider keys: `anthropic`; model count: `7`.
  - Models: `claude-fable-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, `claude-opus-4-6`, `claude-opus-4-7`, `claude-opus-4-8`, `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
- Real CLI/catalog visibility proof:
  - Source CLI command: `models list --all --provider anthropic --json` under the same isolated env.
  - Observed result: `count: 7` with model keys `anthropic/claude-fable-5`, `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5`, `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, `anthropic/claude-opus-4-6`, `anthropic/claude-opus-4-7`, `anthropic/claude-opus-4-8`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6`.
- Gateway catalog proof:
  - Source gateway catalog owner path: `loadGatewayModelCatalog({ readOnly: true })` from `src/gateway/server-model-catalog.ts` under the same isolated env.
  - Observed result at `2026-07-03T13:52:28.905Z`: `catalogCount: 259`, `anthropicCount: 7`.
  - Anthropic ids from the gateway catalog path: `claude-fable-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, `claude-opus-4-6`, `claude-opus-4-7`, `claude-opus-4-8`, `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
- Gateway warning-loop proof:
  - `startGatewayServer(minimal gateway) + callGateway(models.list view=all)` ran from `2026-07-03T13:35:13.058Z` to `2026-07-03T13:37:50.468Z`, including a 130-second observation window.
  - Redacted stdout/stderr log scan: `FsSafeError: 0`, `directory changed during operation: 0`, `[model-catalog] Failed to load model catalog: 0`.
  - The minimal gateway proof intentionally used a reduced startup path, so that run proves daemon stability/no warning loop; the gateway catalog loader proof above is the run that proves Anthropic sidecar rows are visible through the gateway catalog owner path.
- Focused tests / checks:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts` passed: 2 files, 66 tests.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-model-catalog.test.ts` passed: 2 files, 12 tests.
  - `git diff --check` passed.
- Not tested / proof gaps:
  - No full broad suite or full typecheck was run.
  - Full source `gateway run` with `models.list view=all` was not used as the final proof path because that Windows source-worktree path pulled in slow full discovery/auth availability work; the PR claim is instead covered by the isolated live Anthropic sidecar write, real CLI catalog visibility, focused gateway tests, the gateway catalog owner loader path, and the 130-second gateway no-warning log window.
